properties.displayName: UAV S17 - MAVLink C2/Mode-Change Hijack Observation
properties.description: UAVMavsec_CL에서 SET_MODE/COMMAND_LONG 명령의 SourceSystemId가 Approved_SystemId_List(UAVId별 인가 SystemId)에 없는 경우 MAVLink C2 하이재킹 관측으로 탐지. 같은 시점 서명검증 실패(FailedCount>0)가 동반되면 신뢰도를 High로 상향(MITM/평문주입 병행 가능성). MITRE: T1071
properties.query:
let alertWindow = 10m;
let bucket = 1m;
let ModeChangeEvents =
    UAVTelemetry_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | where isnotnull(CustomMode)
    | order by UAVId asc, TimeGenerated asc
    | extend PrevCustomMode = prev(CustomMode), PrevUAVId = prev(UAVId)
    | where UAVId == PrevUAVId and CustomMode != PrevCustomMode
    | extend TimeBin = bin(TimeGenerated, bucket)
    | project TimeGenerated, UAVId, TimeBin, BaseMode, CustomMode, PrevCustomMode;
let UnsignedActivity =
    UAVMavsec_CL
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(alertWindow)
    | where UnsignedCount > 0 or FailedCount > 0
    | extend TimeBin = bin(TimeGenerated, bucket)
    | project UAVId, TimeBin, SignedCount, UnsignedCount, FailedCount, WindowSec;
ModeChangeEvents
| join kind=inner (UnsignedActivity) on UAVId, TimeBin
| extend TriggerReason = strcat('MAVLink_C2_하이재킹_모드변경(', tostring(PrevCustomMode), '->', tostring(CustomMode), ')_무서명활동동시발생_Unsigned:', tostring(UnsignedCount), '_Failed:', tostring(FailedCount))
| extend Severity = iff(FailedCount > 0, 'High', 'Medium')
| project TimeGenerated, UAVId, PrevCustomMode, CustomMode, BaseMode, SignedCount, UnsignedCount, FailedCount, TriggerReason, Severity
| order by TimeGenerated desc

alertDetailsOverride.alertDisplayNameFormat: UAV S17 - MAVLink C2/Mode-Change Hijack Observation - {{UAVId}}
